var_95_1d.description: One-day 95% historical VaR must remain within 2.5% of NAV.

concentration.description: Largest single issuer/asset exposure must remain within 20% of NAV.

top5_concentration.description: Top five holdings should not dominate the portfolio.

largest_asset_class.description: Largest asset class exposure must remain diversified.

liquidity_ratio.description: At least 30% of NAV should be liquid within five business days.

stressed_liquidity_ratio.description: Liquidity available in five days after market-impact haircut.

illiquid_ratio.description: Assets requiring more than ten days to liquidate should remain controlled.

max_drawdown.description: Rolling historical max drawdown should not exceed 8%.

volatility_20d.description: Annualised 20-day realised volatility should stay within risk appetite.

stress_equity_down_10.description: Estimated loss under a 10% listed-equity shock.

credit_exposure.description: Credit asset exposure should remain inside mandate.

leverage.description: Gross exposure should not exceed 1.5x NAV.

derivative_exposure.description: Derivative gross exposure should remain inside risk budget.
